notes.title: Update & Fix | 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Bunch of small fix that player have reported

- Updated Dream 2 and Dream 3 re working some of his designs
- Added Text prompt to help the player solves certain puzzles
- Added sounds effects to some spiders
- Tweaked the speed of spiders

Thx to all the players for the amazing reviews and gameplay I've been watching. Helping me a lot with my game and making a better product.
